lenses.name: Evidence Boundary
lenses.when: Evidence, planning authority, generated records, manifests, release artifacts, or tests that validate them changed.
lenses.instruction: Apply the canonical evidence-boundary runbook. Verify independently recomputed hashes and signable payloads, repository-contained paths, exact changed-path and frozen-inventory equality, raw-mode gitlink exclusion, pinned roots of trust, visible unavailable-history handling, non-vacuous execution, and red-capable named faults.
